Reporting to: Senior Manager
A.C. Goulding Services Pty Ltd delivers high-quality air conditioning and refrigeration solutions across commercial projects. We specialise in tailored systems designed to meet complex project requirements and deliver optimal performance in every environment.
About the Role
We are seeking a skilled and reliable Service Technician to install, maintain and repair commercial, industrial and domestic refrigeration and air conditioning systems. This role requires strong technical capability, attention to detail, and the ability to diagnose and resolve faults efficiently.
Key Responsibilities
•	Interpret technical drawings and specifications to determine job requirements and installation reference points
•	Install systems and components including compressors, motors, condensers, evaporators, switches and gauges
•	Perform pipework installation including cutting, bending, threading and joining (brazing, welding and soldering)
•	Conduct system testing, including pressure and leak testing using gas or fluid
•	Commission new systems and perform test operations, adjustments and calibrations
•	Diagnose faults and carry out repairs and component replacements
•	Conduct routine servicing and preventative maintenance
•	Respond to breakdowns and complete urgent repairs as required
•	Maintain accurate service records, including fault identification and corrective actions taken

Skills & Experience
•	Relevant trade qualification in Refrigeration and Air Conditioning
•	Current and valid driver’s licence
•	Minimum 2 years’ relevant industry experience
•	Demonstrated experience in servicing, maintenance and breakdown diagnostics
•	Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding skills

The role suits someone who is organised, proactive, and capable of managing competing priorities in a multi-site business environment.

Coordinate accounts payable, receivable, and invoice processing

Maintain accurate records, filing systems, and documentation

At least 3 years’ experience in an office management, administration management, or senior administrative role

N K Transport AUS Pty Ltd is a Queensland-based transport and logistics company providing courier, interstate freight, specialised transportation and logistics solutions across Australia. With a modern fleet, an in-house mechanical workshop and a strong commitment to reliability, safety and operational efficiency, the company delivers tailored transport services to a diverse range of commercial clients.

Role Overview
We are seeking a qualified and experienced Automotive Electrician to join our workshop team in Pinkenba, Queensland. The successful candidate will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing, maintaining and installing electrical and electronic systems across the company's fleet of commercial vehicles and transport equipment to ensure safe, reliable and efficient operations.

Key Responsibilities
• Diagnose faults in electrical and electronic systems using specialised diagnostic equipment and testing instruments.
• Test, repair and replace electrical components including sensors, switches, relays, control modules and associated wiring.
• Install and maintain electronic accessories such as GPS tracking systems, reversing cameras, telematics, communication equipment and safety devices.

result.description:
We are looking for an experienced and strategic ICT Manager to lead the planning, development, and day-to-day management of our organisation's information and communication technology systems. This role is central to ensuring our technology infrastructure supports business objectives effectively and securely. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical knowledge, sound leadership capability, and the ability to translate complex ICT requirements into practical solutions. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to drive digital initiatives and maintain a reliable, secure, and efficient ICT environment.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse organisational information needs and specify appropriate technology solutions to meet current and future business requirements
Formulate, implement, and continuously review ICT strategies, policies, and operational plans aligned with broader organisational goals
Direct the evaluation, procurement, and installation of ICT hardware, software, and infrastructure, ensuring value for money and fitness for purpose
Oversee the security and integrity of all ICT systems, including risk assessments, data protection compliance, and incident response planning
Set priorities and allocate resources across system development, maintenance, and daily operations to ensure continuity of service
Lead and manage the ICT team, including recruitment, performance management, professional development, and workload planning
Direct the provision of user training and technical support, ensuring staff are equipped to use systems effectively
Manage vendor and contractor relationships, including negotiating contracts, monitoring service levels, and ensuring delivery against agreed outcomes
Develop and manage ICT budgets, tracking expenditure and identifying opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising performance
Oversee the implementation of new systems and technology projects, managing timelines, risks, and stakeholder communication throughout
Ensure ICT operations comply with relevant legislation, industry standards, and internal governance frameworks
Produce and present regular reports on ICT performance, project progress, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
Proven experience in an ICT management or senior technical leadership role, typically five or more years
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement ICT strategies, policies, and operational frameworks
Strong knowledge of network infrastructure, systems administration, cybersecurity principles, and cloud-based technologies
Experience managing budgets, vendor contracts, and procurement processes within an ICT context
Solid understanding of data privacy legislation and information security standards, including ISO 27001 or equivalent
Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to mentor and develop technical teams
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with a structured approach to decision-making
Effective communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience delivering ICT projects using recognised project management methodologies such as PRINCE2 or Agile
Preferred Qualifications
Postgraduate qualification in IT management, business administration, or a related field
Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CISSP, or equivalent
Experience working within regulated industries or government environments
Familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) or customer relationship management (CRM) platforms
Knowledge of COBIT or other IT governance frameworks
Experience leading digital transformation or large-scale systems migration projects
Why Join Us?
Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation that genuinely values technology as a driver of business success
Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including funded certifications and leadership programmes
Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options to support work-life balance
Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation and performance-based incentives
Contribute to meaningful projects that have a real impact on organisational outcomes and service delivery
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super

result.description: A & M Packaging Pty Ltd  A & M Packaging Pty Limited is a leading Australian provider of flexible packaging solutions, committed to quality, innovation, and operational excellence. We provide comprehensive services ranging from packaging design and lamination to conversion and distribution. We are currently seeking a highly skilled Quality Engineering Officer to join our team and drive technical optimization across our manufacturing operations.  The Quality Engineering Officer will play a critical role in optimizing our packaging production lines and manufacturing technologies. You will be responsible for analysing system performance, implementing process improvements, and ensuring that our manufacturing workflows operate at peak efficiency, quality, and compliance. This role bridges the gap between production and engineering, requiring a hands-on approach to technical troubleshooting, equipment validation, and data-driven continuous improvement.   Benefits   Task & responsibilities   Evaluate manufacturing lines and equipment performance to pinpoint opportunities for increasing productivity, efficiency, and product quality.  Conduct root cause analysis on equipment failures and process anomalies, implementing engineering-based solutions to restore and enhance operational reliability.  Formulate and execute process improvement strategies aimed at maximizing resource utilization and reducing operational waste.  Assess production methods against established technical specifications and engineering standards to ensure all manufacturing processes remain within defined parameters.  Provide hands-on technical guidance and troubleshooting for production machinery and process technologies to mitigate downtime and boost system output.  Design, refine, and enforce technical documentation, standard operating procedures, and process controls to maintain consistency in production outcomes.  Partner with production, quality, and engineering teams to streamline packaging systems and refine manufacturing workflows.  Participate in the commissioning, testing, and validation of new manufacturing assets to ensure they meet performance and engineering benchmarks.  Develop and oversee testing and inspection protocols to verify process capability and maintain rigorous product performance standards.  Analyse production metrics and performance data to identify operational trends, supporting the implementation of continuous improvement projects.  Assist in the maintenance of operational and quality management frameworks to ensure alignment with industry regulations and internal business requirements.  Track the success of corrective and preventive actions (CAPA), evaluating the impact of implemented solutions and recommending further technical upgrades where needed.    Qualification & experience   A tertiary qualification (Bachelor’s degree or Higher) in Engineering, Engineering Technology, or a related technical discipline.  Proven professional experience in a manufacturing, packaging, or industrial processing environment.  At least 3 years of professional experience in a similar role.  Solid understanding of engineering principles, production workflows, and manufacturing process controls.  Proficiency in utilising ERP systems (e.g., SAP or Microsoft Dynamics 365) for production data analysis and operational monitoring.  Demonstrated ability to conduct root cause analysis, troubleshoot equipment issues, and implement effective engineering solutions.  Excellent communication skills, with the ability to provide technical guidance and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.   About Company    A & M Packaging Pty Limited is a leading Australian manufacturer and supplier of flexible packaging solutions, specializing in high-performance lamination, conversion, and distribution services across the country. We partner with a diverse range of industries to deliver consistently high standards of manufacturing quality, technical precision, and operational efficiency.  With a strong commitment to engineering excellence and service, we provide tailored packaging solutions designed to meet the complex technical requirements of each client. Our business places significant emphasis on process innovation, workplace safety, and continuous improvement to ensure our production systems are highly efficient, reliable, and performance-driven.  At A & M Packaging, our team members are dedicated professionals who take pride in their technical expertise and contribute directly to the innovation and operational success of our manufacturing operations. Job Opportunity: Full-Time Drainer – Mulroy Civil WA 
Location: Burswood, WA
Position Type: Full-Time
Salary: $80,000 to $90,000 + superannuation

About Us:
Mulroy Civil WA is a respected civil construction company delivering high-quality infrastructure across Western Australia. We pride ourselves on safety, reliability, and a strong team culture.

About the Role:
We are seeking a skilled and safety-conscious Drainer to join our civil construction team. In this role, you will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing drainage systems in line with project specifications and safety regulations. You will work closely with site supervisors, machine operators, and other crew members to ensure drainage works are completed efficiently, accurately, and to the highest standard.

Key Duties & Responsibilities:

•	Read and interpret site plans, drainage layouts, and engineering drawings.
•	Install stormwater, sewer, and subsoil drainage systems to specification.
•	Set out and prepare trenches, ensuring correct line, level, and grade.
•	Operate small plant and hand tools required for drainage works.
•	Supervise and assist in excavation works to prevent damage to existing services.
•	Ensure correct compaction and backfilling of trenches.
•	Conduct quality checks to ensure compliance with relevant standards and project requirements.
•	Follow all workplace health and safety procedures and wear appropriate PPE at all times.
•	Work collaboratively with the team to meet deadlines and maintain productivity targets.

Requirements:

•	Relevant qualifications
•	At least 3years’ proven experience as a Drainer in civil construction
•	Ability to read and interpret site plans and specifications
•	Ability to measure, set out, and achieve accurate drainage levels.
•	Knowledge of relevant standards, codes, and best practices in drainage works.
•	Strong focus on safety, quality, and efficiency
•	Physically fit and capable of working in challenging site conditions

What We Offer:

•	Competitive pay rates based on experience.
•	Long-term, ongoing projects with a reputable civil construction company.
•	A supportive team culture with opportunities for skill development.
•	Safe, well-maintained equipment and a strong focus on safety compliance.
•	Ongoing training and development opportunities

How to Apply:
If you’re a skilled Drainer looking for your next opportunity, we want to hear from you!

result.description:
The Client 

Olympic Caravans Pty Ltd is an Australian caravan manufacturer that builds quality caravans from the ground up. They are one of the very few caravan brands to feature aluminium caravans which are designed to last well past the life of a traditional timber frame caravan. 

They now seek an experienced Carpenter to join their team in Campbellfield, VIC. 

 

 

The Role 

The Carpenter is responsible for carrying out residential carpentry works including framing, installation, finishing, and structural construction activities in accordance with project specifications and building requirements. 

This is a full-time position with an annual salary set at $80,000 plus superannuation. The role is based in Campbellfield, VIC. 

 

The Responsibilities 

Install fixtures, windows, cabinetry and trims to enhance interior aesthetics and functionality 

Fit door locksets, deadbolts and hardware according to manufacturer instructions and site requirements 

Perform framing, finish work and restoration carpentry tasks across residential construction projects 

Measure, shape and cut materials to specified dimensions using hand tools, machines and power saws 

Read and interpret plans, measurements and site instructions for carpentry work 

Construct and install structural frameworks, partitions, floors and roof components in accordance with project specifications 

Assemble and install timber structures, fittings and prefabricated building materials on residential sites 

Operate and maintain carpentry tools, woodworking machinery and construction equipment safely and efficiently 

Maintain high standards of workmanship, cleanliness and workplace safety across all carpentry activities 

 

The Requirements 

Certificate III in Carpentry or equivalent trade qualification 

At least 2 years’ experience as a Carpenter in a professional commercial capacity 

At least 2 years’ experience performing framing, finishing, and general carpentry installation works in caravan carpentry fabrication and installation 

At least 2 year’s carpentry experience with LVL (Laminated Veneer Lumber) and CLT (Cross Laminated Timber) structural components 

At least 2 year’s carpentry experience installing and detailing HCS (Hybrid Cladding Systems), R/S (Roof Sarking), and VCL (Vapour Control Layer) with moisture management and weatherproofing specifications. 

At least 2 year’s experience coordinating carpentry interfaces with engineered substrates including GLT beams, PFC, and commercial-grade acoustic and fire-rated timber systems 

At least 2 years’ experience installing doors, windows, cabinetry, trims, and structural timber components in caravan carpentry 

Ability to measure, cut, assemble, and install materials accurately to project specifications 

Strong understanding of workplace health and safety procedures and construction compliance standards 

Ability to work independently and coordinate effectively with other trades and site personnel 

Good communication and problem-solving skills within construction site environments 

High attention to detail and commitment to workmanship quality
